name: GsplatVolumeLighting
definition: A volume lighting and occlusion technique for 3D Gaussian Splatting that ray-marches through a 3D density texture to compute transmittance for shadow/volume occlusion, combined with per-light attenuation and diffuse shading.
summary: GsplatVolumeLighting is a volume lighting and occlusion technique for 3D Gaussian Splatting that ray-marches through a 3D density texture to compute transmittance for shadows and volume occlusion.
